description: Jest's documented custom snapshot matcher (B23e, D128) on multi-line values that differ: a first local run stores them, then the captured run under `--ci` (the test file sends other values once the .snap exists) fails both with jest-snapshot 30.5.2's own diff, which it prints with `this.snapshotState.expand` (off: a long list is cut to the changed lines and 5 around them) and, for a multi-line received value, serializes again with `this.snapshotState.snapshotFormat` (`escapeString` and `printBasicPrototype` false: quotes stay bare, no `Object` or `Array` prefix). `custom-snapshot-format-expand` is the same run with `--expand`. One file, one worker.
